correctness.rationale: The stationary (X,Y) Markov generator on x^i y^j is −(i+ρ1_{j>0})x^iy^j+i x^{i−1}y^{j+1}+j(j−1)x^iy^{j−2}. Independently solved all degree≤4 moment recurrences, built 6×6 cubic semigroup generator in basis (x³,x²y,xy²,y³,x,y), and used rational matrix resolvent to verify the claimed exact Laplace transform of Aρ(t)=E[X0³Xt]−E[X0Xt³] for arbitrary symbolic ρ,p>0. Fresh direct matrix-generator differentiation gave derivatives n=0,1,2 identically zero, n=3 equal 72(2ρ²−3ρ−3)/(ρ(ρ+1)²(ρ+2)(ρ+3)) and n=4 equal −24(7ρ²−14ρ−12)/(ρ(ρ+1)²(ρ+2)), positive at ρ*=(3+√33)/4. Leading pole residues give negative long-lag for ρ<1 and positive for ρ>1, with explicit ρ=1 double pole; hence 1<ρ<ρ* has a sign reversal. Sign symmetry kills lower odd moments, covariance symmetry kills degree two, proving fourth-degree first nonzero witness; all moments finite under exponential renewal ages.
